request: Can you make the Temple of Heaven in Beijing as a 3D print, 18 cm across?

tallest.why: The Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests, the part people mean, to the top of its finial.

dimensions.why: The three round terraces' base, 90 m across, is the widest thing on it.

why: Wikidata's Temple of Heaven is the whole park and the map has the hall as one 28 m drum: the three terraces, the stairs, the columns and the three round roofs come from the pack.
